crossRefs.note: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations;’
“Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
Of the children of Ammon. Yahweh says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his…
Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against…
The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in…
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment…

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
translations.bsb: “I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.
translations.kjv: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
translations.asv: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, wherewith they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
